# T04 — STATE REVIEW COVERAGE MATRIX

```
STAGE    = 4.2F-B1.1
SUITE_ID = T04_STATE_COVERAGE_QA_v1
STATUS   = T04_LAYOUT_STORYBOARD_BUILT
TOTAL_STATES        = 65
BEFORE_APPENDIX     = 13 covered, 52 not
AFTER_APPENDIX      = 65 covered, 0 not
DECISION            = T04_INTERACTION_STATE_REVIEW_COVERAGE_PROVEN
```

A state is review-covered only if the artifact answers all five of these:

1. what triggers the state
2. what content appears in it
3. how it differs from the base state
4. how the learner returns or continues
5. which source and authority records support it

Text being present somewhere on the page satisfies none of 1, 3 or 4, and a state name in a list satisfies none of them at all.
